$comment: PromptWheel security guard-pack. Decanted from securitychecks (recommended tier). Use via { "extends": ["packs/security/pack.json"] } in your promptwheel.config.json. Gates on the count of security-invariant violations (direction: down = lower is better; guard: true = fail if it climbs). Because it's a promptwheel metric, the win must survive --detect-gaming: an agent can't lower the count by editing the pattern file or a config, only by fixing the code.
